svg.title: org_tree — downward traversal with unified color scheme
svg.desc: Downward recursive CTE: amber = VP anchor start, purple = recursive step and direct reports level, teal = leaf endpoint (their reports), coral = final output.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the anchor member of org_tree do, and why start at a VP?')
sendPrompt('How does the recursive step in org_tree fan downward through all reports?')
sendPrompt('What does the final SELECT return from org_tree?')
sendPrompt('Why is the VP the anchor in org_tree and how is it selected?')
sendPrompt('What is depth 1 in the org_tree traversal?')
sendPrompt('What is depth 2+ in org_tree and when does the recursion stop?')
